D321284 review preparation renamed the session and draft Redux modules to `calendarEventCreateEditSessionSlice.mjs` and `calendarEventDraftSlice.mjs`: `Slice.mjs` is required by state-management guidance and selects Redux lint rules. Imports and sorted `moz.build` entries must follow the final names. The prepared changes were unstaged; focused ESLint and `git diff --check` passed, while native/browser tests remained blocked or unrun. [ad-hoc note]
